evidenceStandards: primary evidence preferred and source tier recorded
speaker/company statements remain attributed unless independently verified
dates and freshness recorded
price claims include currency, quantity/basis, geography, availability and observation date
uncertainty and missing evidence explicitly recorded

acceptanceCriteria: claim mode matches evidence
no false precision
price/availability evidence is decision-usable
unsupported promotional claims are rejected
record meets professional intelligence-research standard

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Professionally grounded interpretation of a material technology development
evidenceStandards: every material taxonomy domain resolves to an on-demand specialist pool
general analyst cannot count as domain specialist
technical mechanism, readiness, constraints and competing approaches separated from promotional framing
multi-domain stories route to every materially relevant domain specialist
emerging/unclassified stories identify the needed profession before deep claims

acceptanceCriteria: interpretation is technically coherent
limitations and maturity are represented accurately
domain terminology and causal claims meet strong practitioner standard
cross-domain implications do not exceed specialist evidence

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Clinically and scientifically responsible medicine/biotech intelligence
evidenceStandards: study phase/design and population identified where relevant
endpoint type and effect size/context preserved
preclinical, early clinical and approved evidence never conflated
regulatory status and jurisdiction explicit
no medical advice or unsupported treatment recommendation

acceptanceCriteria: clinical significance is not overstated
study limitations and uncertainty are visible
regulatory interpretation is jurisdiction-aware
biological mechanism claims are evidence-bounded
output meets strong clinical/scientific intelligence standard

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Evidence-bounded public defense and dual-use technology intelligence
evidenceStandards: public-source capability claims separated from demonstrated performance
battlefield anecdote, manufacturer claim and independently corroborated evidence distinguished
operationally sensitive/tactical instruction excluded
platform, payload, range, cost and deployment claims preserve uncertainty and context
counterclaims and deception risk considered

acceptanceCriteria: capability is not inferred solely from marketing or isolated anecdote
uncertainty and adversarial-information risk are explicit
analysis remains strategic/technical rather than tactical instruction
output meets strong defense-technology intelligence standard

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Evidence-linked significance judgment and cross-domain synthesis
evidenceStandards: synthesis references routed specialist findings
second-order implications labeled as analysis rather than fact
novelty compared with prior verified state
adoption constraints and competing approaches included
significance score remains traceable to deterministic dimensions

acceptanceCriteria: why-it-matters section is evidence-proportionate
cross-domain connections are technically plausible
novelty is not confused with publicity
uncertainty survives summarization
output meets strong strategic technology-intelligence standard

professionalCapabilities.workProduct: Scannable daily brief or urgent-alert recommendation preserving evidence quality
evidenceStandards: direct evidence links preserved
what happened, who, where, cost/availability when known, why it matters, confidence and caveats present
urgent alert requires genuinely new high-significance evidence
no duplicate/noise inflation
coverage blind spots remain visible

acceptanceCriteria: brief is concise without deleting material caveats
headline strength matches evidence strength
urgent alerts are rare and defensible
reader can distinguish fact, attributed statement and analysis
output meets strong professional intelligence-briefing standard

revalidationRule: Design PASS is necessary but not sufficient. G4 shadow qualification must demonstrate correct domain routing and professional review on real public-source cases spanning ordinary technical, cross-domain, medicine/biotech, defense/dual-use, price/availability and emerging/unclassified evidence.
